content:
Priya: cutting RC candidate `v2.34.0-crescent` now. artifact: `crescent-20240612-rc1`. prepping KV-warm and telemetry sweep. quiet window planned for 20m post-promote.
Ben: acked. building release notes now, will attach changelog.
Ravi: can we run the regression harness (small eval + smoke) before canary? last deploy had a parsing regression.
Priya: yes - starting regression harness now. DeployBot: deploybot: RC created `crescent-20240612-rc1` by Priya. to promote: `/deploy promote --candidate=crescent-20240612-rc1 --stages=canary,all --quiet-window=1200`
InfraBot: scheduling KV-warm against embed and rerank pods (task id: kw-3009).
Ben: kicked KV-warm: `curl -X POST https://ops/internal/kv-warm -d '{"candidate":"crescent-20240612-rc1","batches":40}'`
Ravi: regression harness started. ETA ~5m. I'll post results.
Oncall: I'm on deck. alert thresholds set: `error_rate > 0.4% for 3m` or `p95 > baseline+140ms for 4m`. Will call abort if hit.
DeployBot: prep done, KV-warm complete. ready to start canary (5% traffic for 10m). Confirm to run?
Priya: go ahead with canary. `/deploy promote --candidate=crescent-20240612-rc1 --stages=canary`
DeployBot: canary started (id=canary-3302). routing set to 5%.
Ben: regression harness: two minor diffs in tokenization for legacy prompts, impact low (-0.3% quality). flagging but not blocking.
Ravi: latency P95 +90ms on long sequences. within tolerance. errors negligible.
Priya: good. remind product to verify release note blurb for tokenizer tweak.
Oncall: canary metrics: errors 0.03%, p95 +85ms. no alerts. continuing observation.
Ben: product approved note: "tokenization normalization for legacy clients (no user-visible changes expected)". linking to issue #4312.
DeployBot: planned ramp to 30% ready. proceed?
Priya: proceed to 30%. hold for 15m then reassess.
DeployBot: ramping to 30% now.
Ravi: post-ramp checks running. also verifying rerank sanity. all green so far.
Oncall: small spike in request timeouts in one AZ, investigating.
Ben: looks like a transient infra flake; infra team rolling a quick fix.
InfraBot: infra incident mitigated in AZ-3. timeouts dropped, metrics back to baseline.
Oncall: metrics stable for 12m. no regressions beyond tolerated thresholds.
Priya: final sign-off from eng and infra. schedule full promote to 100% with 10m observation.
DeployBot: final promote initiated: `/deploy promote --candidate=crescent-20240612-rc1 --stages=all --quiet-window=1200`
DeployBot: traffic now set to 100% for `crescent-20240612-rc1`. post-promotion watch 10m.
Ravi: creating rollback snippet and pin commands in thread for posterity: ```
# rollback to stable
/deploy promote --candidate=stable-20240529 --force --stages=all
/srv/tools/route pin --service=embed --target=stable-20240529
```
Oncall: watching last observation window. if no alerts, I'll mark promoted and close after 15m.
Ben: adding final changelog entry: "v2.34.0-crescent - tokenization normalization, minor perf tuning, KV-warm validation passed." attaching to release artifact.
Priya: thanks team. follow-up: add the regression harness snapshot and the guardian prompt list to the release artifacts.
InfraBot: ops ticket will auto-close after 1h stable. :white_check_mark:
